name: owner_disp_oside_1_cdl_r05

source.title: Owner's idea, 2026-10-19 (third): displacement against the side of the 09:30 open, stop at the displacement candle's extreme, 1:0.5

entry.words: Use 9:30: if we are above the 9:30 open level then short, below then long; enter when we get displacement, 1 trade a day, 30 point stop, try 1:0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5. Displacement: the body of the candle must be larger than the body of the previous candle and close above the wick of the previous candle.

taught: [chat 2026-10-19] the 09:30 open sets the side: above = shorts, below = longs
[chat 2026-10-19] displacement = body larger than the previous candle's body, close beyond the previous candle's wick
[chat 2026-10-19] stop = the displacement candle's extreme (owner: use the displacement candle extreme as the stop)
not_run: BARS: 1-minute. Claude's pick (1m and 5m both run).
THE STOP: the candle's low (long) / high (short), measured from its close; the engine floors it at 0.25 ATR and two ticks.
SIDE: price vs the 09:30 open is read on the displacement candle's close. Claude's pick.
THE ENTRY: a market order at the displacement candle's close. Claude's pick.
WINDOW: not said; entries 09:30-15:00, flat 15:58. Claude's pick.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ: this is build days only.
